name: Yuuki Tomoko
source:
Tomoko is a fast worker. She's both a good scholar and a good warrior. Tomoko is part of the Student Council; she takes care of routine duties and even the work [url=/c98202]Himari[/url], the Student Council President, cannot accomplish. Tomoko has a serious but calm personality most of the time, although she is said to have another side that is very ruthless and comes out whenever she holds a sword.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]

She has a sword named "Pyonpyonmaru."
